label: archaeology card
purpose: Step-6 synthesis card. Consumes a pre-computed metrics bag (or computes one inline from the standard inputs) and renders a single verdict + reason + interpretation + per-metric numeric table. Pulls together polarity, age class, integrity, mosaicism, frequency, π/dXY/FST, private/fixed counts, confidence.
input_contract: atlasState.inversion.archaeology_card_state = { metrics: { pi_inv, pi_std, dxy, fst_hudson, private_inv, private_std, fixed_differences, arrangement_frequency?, leakage_score?, n_regimes?, outgroup_present?, polarity_verdict?, age_class? }, candidate_label?, opts? }
computed_preview_outputs: per-metric numeric table (π_inv, π_std, dXY, F_ST, private/fixed counts, ...)
